newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: ABN AMRO unit buys 35 pct of Thai firm.
newsitem.headline: ABN AMRO unit buys 35 pct of Thai firm.

text.p: Dutch bank ABN AMRO NV's ABN AMRO Hoare Govett Asia (Holdings) Ltd unit said on Thursday it had accepted tenders for 46 million shares, or 35 percent of Asia Securities Trading Public Co.
It said the transaction was valued at 1.6 billion baht at the offer price of 35 baht per share in AST.
The offer to buy between 35 and 49 percent of the Thai securities house expired on Monday and shareholders who tendered their shares will be paid today.
The bid, launched in May, is part of the Dutch bank's plans to expand its presence in Asia.

"We are delighted that our offer has been successful, and we are now looking forward to forging an even closer working relationship than we already have with the management and staff of AST," ABN AMRO Hoare Govett Asia managing director David Roberts said in a statement.
ABN AMRO Hoare Govett Asia, 70 percent owned by ABN AMRO, held no shares in AST before launching its tender offer but the two companies have been co-operating since 1991.
Hong Kong's Guoco Group owns the other 30 percent of ABN AMRO Hoare Govett Asia.
